technical_analysis.issue: Native iPhone/Xcode test app showed stale reduced-access UI despite TEST_MODE=true in .env
technical_analysis.root_cause: Create-React-App only embeds REACT_APP_* prefixed env vars into production bundles. TEST_MODE was not prefixed, so it was baked as false/undefined in the iOS bundle.
technical_analysis.fix_applied: 1) Changed testMode.js to read REACT_APP_TEST_MODE, 2) Added DefinePlugin in craco.config.js to embed REACT_APP_TEST_MODE, 3) Added REACT_APP_TEST_MODE=true to frontend/.env, 4) Updated iOS scripts to use REACT_APP_TEST_MODE with fallback
technical_analysis.fix_correctness: VERIFIED - Production build now contains REACT_APP_TEST_MODE:"true" embedded in the compiled JavaScript bundle
technical_analysis.remaining_blockers: None from repo/build side. User should rebuild iOS app on macOS to verify the fix on device.
